requirements.title: Members earn points per dollar
requirements.statement: Base earning rule for the loyalty programme.

criteria.text: Members earn 1 point per whole dollar of the subtotal.

requirements.title: Tier multipliers
requirements.statement: Gold, Silver and Bronze earn at different rates.

criteria.text: Silver members earn 1.5 times the points, rounded down.
Bronze members earn the base points.

requirements.title: Points expire after 12 months
requirements.statement: Unused points expire on the anniversary of the day they were earned.

criteria.text: Points earned on a date expire 12 months later, on the same day of the month.

links.summary: Points expire 12 months after they are earned

requirements.title: Referral bonus
requirements.statement: Members who refer a friend get a bonus.

criteria.text: A member earns 250 points when a friend they referred has their first order delivered, if the member has ordered before.

requirements.title: Points calculation time
requirements.statement: Calculating the points for an order takes under 50 ms at the 95th percentile, measured at the loyalty service, for orders of up to 100 lines.

criteria.text: Calculating the points for an order takes under 50 ms at the 95th percentile, measured at the loyalty service, for orders of up to 100 lines.

requirements.title: Points history retention
requirements.statement: A member's points history is kept for 7 years after their last order.

criteria.text: A member's points history is kept for 7 years after their last order.
